  Int.ofNat (BitVec.toNat (x - y)) = (Int.ofNat (BitVec.toNat x) - Int.ofNat (BitVec.toNat y)).fmod (2 ^ 63)

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63ShiftSpecs.leftShiftSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x p : NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.Word),
  Int.ofNat (x <<< BitVec.toNat p).toNat = (Int.ofNat (BitVec.toNat x) * 2 ^ BitVec.toNat p).fmod (2 ^ 63)

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63ShiftSpecs.rightShiftSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x p : NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.Word),
  Int.ofNat (x >>> BitVec.toNat p).toNat = (Int.ofNat (BitVec.toNat x)).fdiv (2 ^ BitVec.toNat p)

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63CountSpecs.leadingZeroSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x : NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.Word),
  0 < BitVec.toNat x →
    2 ^ 62 ≤ 2 ^ (BitVec.clz x).toNat * BitVec.toNat x ∧ 2 ^ (BitVec.clz x).toNat * BitVec.toNat x < 2 ^ 63

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63CountSpecs.trailingZeroSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x : NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.Word),
  0 < BitVec.toNat x → ∃ y, BitVec.toNat x = (2 * y + 1) * 2 ^ (BitVec.ctz x).toNat

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Operations.comparisonSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x y : NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63UnsignedSupport.Word),
  (if BitVec.toInt x < BitVec.toInt y then Ordering.lt
    else if BitVec.toInt y < BitVec.toInt x then Ordering.gt else Ordering.eq) =
    compare (BitVec.toInt x) (BitVec.toInt y)

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Operations.lessEqualSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x y : NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63UnsignedSupport.Word),
  decide (BitVec.toInt x ≤ BitVec.toInt y) = true ↔ compare (BitVec.toInt x) (BitVec.toInt y) ≠ Ordering.gt

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Operations.lessSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x y : NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63UnsignedSupport.Word),
  decide (BitVec.toInt x < BitVec.toInt y) = true ↔ compare (BitVec.toInt x) (BitVec.toInt y) = Ordering.lt

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Operations.minimum
native_expression: BitVec.ofNat 63 (2 ^ 62)

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Operations.signedInteger
native_expression: fun x => BitVec.toInt x

name: BitVec.sdiv
native_expression:
fun {n} x y =>
  match x.msb, y.msb with
  | false, false => x.udiv y
  | false, true => (x.udiv y.neg).neg
  | true, false => (x.neg.udiv y).neg
  | true, true => x.neg.udiv y.neg

name: BitVec.srem
native_expression:
fun {n} x y =>
  match x.msb, y.msb with
  | false, false => x.umod y
  | false, true => x.umod y.neg
  | true, false => (x.neg.umod y).neg
  | true, true => (x.neg.umod y.neg).neg

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Specs.arithmeticShift
native_expression: fun x p => if BitVec.toInt p < 0 then 0 else BitVec.sshiftRight x (BitVec.toNat p)

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Specs.arithmeticShiftSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x p : NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63UnsignedSupport.Word),
  BitVec.toInt (NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Specs.arithmeticShift x p) =
    (BitVec.toInt x).fdiv (NativeBridge.Incremental.BinaryPower.zPowNative 2 (BitVec.toInt p))

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Specs.signedDivisionSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x y : NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63UnsignedSupport.Word),
  BitVec.toInt x ≠ -2 ^ 62 ∨ BitVec.toInt y ≠ -1 → (BitVec.sdiv x y).toInt = (BitVec.toInt x).tdiv (BitVec.toInt y)

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63Specs.signedRemainderSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x y : NativeBridge.Incremental.Sint63UnsignedSupport.Word),
  (BitVec.srem x y).toInt = (BitVec.toInt x).tmod (BitVec.toInt y)

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63WideSpecs.doubleDivisionSpec
native_expression:
∀ (hi lo b : NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.Word),
  BitVec.toNat hi < BitVec.toNat b →
    NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63WideSpecs.doubleDividend hi lo / BitVec.toNat b % 2 ^ 63 =
        NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63WideSpecs.doubleDividend hi lo / BitVec.toNat b ∧
      NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63WideSpecs.doubleDividend hi lo % BitVec.toNat b % 2 ^ 63 =
        NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63WideSpecs.doubleDividend hi lo % BitVec.toNat b

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63WideSpecs.wideProductSpec
native_expression:
∀ (x y : NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.Word),
  BitVec.toNat x * BitVec.toNat y =
    BitVec.toNat (NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63WideSpecs.highProduct x y) * 2 ^ 63 +
      BitVec.toNat (NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63WideSpecs.lowProduct x y)
